dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Highly visible thick white horizontal bands with sharp grayscale contrast against dark brown median and greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent sharp white boundaries visible along the edges of folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Elongated, linear white stripe extending from the posterior neck down the center of the dorsal plane.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct linear transition where the dark brown crown meets the high-contrast white dorsal stripe.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous white longitudinal stripe bisecting the dark brown dorsal plumage.
